steps.speaker: Banyan Medical College Classified Records
steps.content:
Top-Secret File: BM-104078Mxc
Security Clearance: Ultra-High
Source of Case: Nirvana
Sinner: Affirmative
Threat Level: S
This case is riddled with anomalies and presents a complicated medical mystery, warranting an in-depth analysis.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: ...I've got this, you're not going to die on my watch.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: I'll get us back, all of us. I promise to bring every single one of us back safely.

steps.speaker: Banyan Medical College Classified Records
steps.content:
Multiple incursions into the Black Ring within a brief span, experiencing over 100 hours of subjective time inside. A sharp spike in the M-value suggests a rise from A to S.

Unusually, the individual has yet to reach the ultimate collapse stage, even without extra safety measures in place—an exceptionally rare occurrence.

Yet, the Black Ring has left an indelible mark on him, manifesting in lasting symptoms such as auditory hallucinations, relentless nightmares, and ongoing post-traumatic stress.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: They're still there... still in the mine...

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: Donald, don't go, you've done this too many times. Your body can't take it anymore...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: No, I have to go. I led them here; it's on me... to bring them back...
His body, pushed to the brink, can't hold up any longer. He falls on the twisty trail, right at the fringe of the tainted area, next to the trap.
Before Samuel can gear up and rush back to the rescue, another squad gets to him first.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: ...This is the man. According to our observation, he's the most powerful Sinner among the rebel group and the focal point of their spirit.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: Without his influence, the rebel group in the mine started to waver, shaking the foundations of Rustfire.
Spot-on analysis, X.
Nirvana's got a serious grudge against him, can't wait to see him gone. But you, you've got a different take, right? Let's hear your thoughts.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: ...Nirvana's approach is way too rough around the edges, making the city-state pay a hefty, unnecessary price. If possible, I'd like to optimize the plan.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: Since this man is their leader, perhaps I could make use of him... and that would reduce some cost.

steps.speaker: Banyan Medical College Classified Records
steps.content:
In addition to the S-Class Mania from the Ring, his mind has endured a more meticulously orchestrated breakdown.

He is in a state of intense internal conflict, exhibiting severe symptoms of manipulation, dissociation, and deep subconscious conditioning.

Our facility has made several attempts to acquire detailed treatment records, but these requests have consistently been denied.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: What's the latest with Rustfire? Really rough, I guess... Look, Samuel, I can no longer do anything for the crew.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: There's this woman from Paradeisos, slapped a "mark" on me. Goes like this—the more I despise her, the more I fight back, the more strength I use, the tighter her strings pull on me. Ha... sounds like a bad joke, huh?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: But it's no joke... I can't stand up to her. She told me to turn on Rustfire, and I just followed suit. Ha... I once thought I was unbeatable, now I'm too chicken to even try my powers!

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Sorry, Samuel, I'm no hero for Rustfire anymore...

steps.speaker: Banyan Medical College Classified Records
steps.content:
His mind is deeply scarred, his awareness tangled in utter chaos. Apart from these conditions, he's also sunk into a deep pit of self-rejection.

As of now, he's still held in a high-security psychiatric ward. He's utterly confused, can't communicate, mentally unstable, and there's no hint of getting better anytime soon.

steps.speaker: Banyan Medical College Classified Records
steps.content: A comeback looks pretty unlikely—we might as well call it... a miracle, if it ever happens.
Samuel searches far and wide, forever it seems, for just a hint of this miracle—to bring back their leader.
[Entering Memory]

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Stop selling yourself short, and forget about needing "someone stronger." You're strong in your own right, and there's plenty out there ready to back you up. You've never been the underdog.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Go and chase down your dreams by any means necessary. It's up to you now.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: In return, I'll block all the tailgaters here, making sure you've got a clear run.
[Pikachu discharges! Cut back to reality.

Corruptors, wreaking havoc, are broadly stunned by electric shocks. Lightning coils around Donald, purging the blight and toppling the high walls. It's been ages since he's wielded his powers; this bet, he admits, brings an unexpected thrill.
But in the heat of power's release, that loathsome "Mark" buried in his mind is reawakened, quietly making its presence felt.
Give in, let me be your voice, I will take control. That's the power of the mark. I can free your friends.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: ..Shut it. I don't care what you're after, just don't bother me now.
Under the red light of the Black Ring, a tempest of Mania sweeps him up, pulling him back into his old madness.

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: The lightning... the power... our leader, our hero... he's back!

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: Why aren't you saving us?!

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Because you're not real! I've embraced the madness, you think this scares me?
He obliterates all the corruption in one swift move. Standing under the Black Ring, confronting the sinister red glow, just like he did nine years ago.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: ...Show yourself, old pal. Nine years apart, you couldn't have forgotten me, right?
A voice, tinged with chaos, slithers out.

steps.speaker: Corpus 002
steps.content: I... I remember...
[Dark Monster Silhouette]

steps.speaker: Corpus 002
steps.content: Heh... It's been ages since I've seen such force... So powerful, capable of wonders, and yet you choose restraint...

steps.speaker: Corpus 002
steps.content: Back then, in the mine, you were the strongest Sinner, the beacon of hope for all... If only it had been you who became Corpseborne, we would never have been beaten by that woman.

steps.speaker: Corpus 002
steps.content: Yet, you chose to be with those cowards, leaving and escaping again and again... Look at yourself now, from once being so bold and spirited, to this sorry state... You've worn yourself down for the sake of the weak...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Heh heh... If you're that worried about me, then just focus your power on me. I'm still in the midst of my tug-of-war game, let's catch up a bit.
He whips his spear around in a full arc, grounding it with a thud, resonating with a forceful clang.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: ...Weak? What's the real meaning of weakness?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Is a number-illiterate leader weak? Is a hot-headed vandal who only knows how to wreak havoc weak? Or you, who've been sneaking and quaking in the shadows for nine long years—are you weak?!

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Is there such a thing as absolute strength? Being weak isn't a crime—it's the world that crushes the weak that's truly monstrous! What gives you the right to judge who gets to live?

Channeling every ounce of his strength, he launches his spear directly at the shadow beneath him. In a flash of electric light, the spear shatters the shadow's corrupt exterior in a single, decisive moment.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: And another thing, don't you ever speak to me with that face... Despicable monster, how dare you!!
[Julien CG]
